title: Casita 3: Ocean Views, Walk to Sandy Beach & Food
description: Welcome to PRdise!Forget your worries in this spacious and serene space. Listen to the waves and the sound of the Coquis as you relax only seven buildings up from Sandy Beach. Walk to a handful of restaurants, bars, shops and waves in this neighborhood. Each unit is unique and has their own private outdoor spaces. There is a shared driveway, outdoor shower, stairs and laundry area that guests can all use. Come enjoy your stay at The Cozy Casitas here at Sandy Beach, Rincon, Puerto Rico!The spaceThe property has an automatic generator that powers on in the event of utility loss. Guests should be mindful of electric consumption while on backup generator power.Guest accessGuests will have access to their private rented casita.The grassy yard, parking, laundry and stairway are shared spaces for all of Cozy Casita guests to enjoy.Other things to noteThere are three (1-bedroom) casitas on property each with their own private patio or balcony area. The driveway, stairs, laundry and grassy yard are shared spaces for all of Cozy Casita guests to access.During your visit you may encounter some of the Caribbean wildlife that live among us. You may hear coquis (our endemic frog), roosters, horses and may receive the visit of iguanas in the trees.There are also many opportunities to observe birds like Venezuelan troupials, red hawks, Puerto Rican parrots and grey kingbirds. Rincon is full of small hills. This property happens to be on one so the driveway until getting used to it may seem a bit steep. A 4x4 is Not necessary.We reserve the right to cancel/limit bookings based on number of nights during Holiday weeks/weekends (3-5 days) Exceptions to the rule apply

title: Dream House
description: This spacious, one story, gated home with pool is centrally located in coveted Rincon. Beautiful Sandy Beach is a 5 min drive as well as lively downtown with restaurants, bars, shops, farmers market and art walk. An open cafe and board walk with amazing sunsets over Dome Beach is just a 10 min drive. At home you can enjoy sunsets from the front porch. Your backyard pool is under swaying palms next to a grilling area and open tiki hut with refrigerator, big screen tv, darts and pool table.The spacePrimary bedroom with queen size bed, two bedrooms with double beds and one bedroom with two single beds.Guest accessGuests can use all of the grounds.Other things to noteThere are mini-split air conditioners for use in the bedrooms in the evenings. They are not intended to run continually.Power outages are common in Rincon and the home is equipped with a Tesla powered backup. This system doesn't power the stove but we have a grill with an additional burner if it is needed while the power is out.Water can also cut off at times but we have a cistern to back that up too.

title: Charming studio steps from the beach!
description: Charming and centrally-located studio.The spaceBeautiful, cozy, charming beach studio centrally located in Rincon. New construction and tastefully decorated. Steps away from the beach, restaurants, city center, shops and a short drive from major attractions including surfing beaches. Located in the first floor for easy access. Gated condominium with private parking. Sofa transforms into a double bed with bed topper included for a comfortable night sleep. Excellent place to stay.

title: Captivating oceanfront nest, beach views, Rincón
description: Relax and enjoy stunning views, outdoor lounge areas alongside the Rincon seascape in a centrally located, quiet and safe neighborhood.This property offers some of the best sunrise and sunset views available on the western side of Puerto Rico! Be within minutes from the best restaurants, night life, shopping, beaches, and other unique cultural activities.The spacePropertyThis guest suite is a bright, light-filled space with gorgeous ocean views! The kitchen offers a stove, oven, full-sized fridge and freezer, and all cook-ready essentials. There is a spacious indoor and outdoor dining area. The bedroom has a queen sized bed, powerful air conditioning unit, high speed fans, and a Smart TV. The bathroom has a step-in shower. Outdoor lounge space faces toward the seascape. All bed linens, bath and beach towels are provided for your stay. All bathroom essentials, like body wash and hand soap, are included.CancellationsWe understand that life happens. As a small business providing local employment, we hope that you understand our need to maintain a consistent cancellation policy. We recommend purchasing trip insurance that covers expenses from last-minute cancellations of lodging and transportation due to theft, medical, etc. Airbnb and Travel Guard offer affordable options to ensure you're covered in the event of the unexpected.PestsPlease note that since we are located on a tropical island, from time to time you may see a dead bug or two in the cottage, especially with warmer and warmer temperatures. This is normal, to be expected and cannot be avoided. Doors should remain closed when possible to minimize pests (i.e. when loading/unloading the car, taking out the trash or hanging out on the porch). Bugs can get inside easily, especially in warmer weather. The cottage is treated inside & out by a pest control company for your comfort and safety.We stay on top of this costly pest control so please help us keep it effective - thank you!Local AnimalsWe love animals and rescued a Puerto Rican “sato” (stray dog), however we kindly ask that you do not feed any stray cats or dogs that are encountered in and around the property. If you feed them they stay and persistently seek more food which becomes difficult and uncomfortable for us as hosts and for other guests, especially those with severe allergies to animals. Let us know if you’d like to rescue a dog or cat, and we can help you!Guest accessGuests have full access to the home.Other things to noteGuests are staying in a private suite (attached to a larger home) with its own entrance and parking space. There is no shared or common spaces.

title: Villa Rocío Beachfront House.
description: Escape to paradise in this beautiful oceanfront beach house nestled in the curves of Rincón, PR! Wake up to the sound of waves crashing and breathtaking ocean views right from your doorstep. Great location: You're just steps away from the vibrant energy of Kaplash and Pal' 21 bars, where you can enjoy delicious food, tropical cocktails, and live music. Yet, the beach feels like your own private oasis.Enjoy direct access to the beach, perfect for sunbathing, swimming, and simply relaxing.The spaceIt has two bedrooms, one with a full size bed and another with a queen bed, sleeps up to 4 people with 1 bath (walking shower), and a private deck with an incredible panoramic ocean view. Private entrance to the beach from the house. You go down 10 steps and you are literally on the beach.Imagine yourself...Sipping your morning coffee as you watch the sunrise over the ocean.Spending lazy afternoons lounging on the sand with a good book.Enjoying a beach in the balcony under the stars.Creating unforgettable memories with family and friends.Guest accessBeach, BBQ, house amenities. Two parking spots available in front of the house.Other things to noteHas TV, AC in both bedrooms and one in the open area (living room and kitchen), fully equipped kitchen, and all amenities. Two private parking spots in front of the house.

description: Casa Edala is a three bedroom, one and a half bath Rincon getaway with a private outdoor saltwater pool and is a two block walk to the beach! You're able to have it all from our location in Stella: short walk to a swimming beach, 5 minute drive to the Plaza and center of town, less than 10 minute drive to the best surfing in the world, or hang out and swim at the property!The spaceCasa Edala offers a relaxing beach vibe while being close to all of Rincón's many beaches, restaurants, and nightlife.All rooms have air conditioning and are fully furnished. Our home has three bedrooms, two equipped with queen sized beds and a third with two single beds. There is a full sized bathroom with large stall shower and an additional half bath that is accessible from the pool deck only. There is also an outdoor shower where guests can hose off sand after returning from the beach.We provide beach gear including beach chairs, umbrella, towels, and a cooler for our guests use. Kitchen is fully equipped with coffee pot, toaster, microwave, oven and everything you would need to cook full meals. While we welcome families be advised the home is not child proof as our pool is not gated. Please note the living space and wrap around covered porch are located on the second floor of the home, this will require guests to climb stairs to access. Unfortunately our home is not handicap accessible. NoGuest accessThe upstairs apartment and all outdoor space is exclusively yours including the pool, sitting areas, wrap around covered porch, and BBQ grill. Perfect for small groups, families, and surfers with plenty of space for boards. The property is fenced and gated and ample street parking space is available.The house is located approximately 45 minutes from the Rafael Hernandez Airport (BQN) in Aguadilla.Other things to notePlease note: while we want guests to enjoy themselves as much as possible this is NOT a party house. Quiet hours are 10p-8am out of respect for our neighbors. No guests aside from those listed on the reservation will be allowed on the property including use of the pool.The neighborhood has many animals including horses and roosters, along with furry friends who like to visit. We recommend ear plugs if you are a light sleeper. No animals are ever permitted in the home. It is important to be aware throughout Puerto Rico we have intermittent power, water, and internet outages. Our home runs on solar power and we have a water tank on property in the event this happens. We recommend you purchase travel insurance to cover these situations, along with weather, and illness.You will have complete privacy during your stay but please be advised property manager lives on site in the first floor apartment.

description: Location is Everything! Two bedroom beach front apartment, centrally located in the heart of Rincon, Puerto Rico. Directly across the street is one of Rincons' beautiful beaches; Balneario of Rincon, and a short 7 minute walk to downtown Rincon, where amazing restaurants and great night life surround the area! Less than a 10 minute drive to El Faro (Lighthouse) Domes Beach, and many other beautiful surrounding beaches. Full kitchen, washer & dryer included. Access to pool & jacuzzi.The spaceThis is a 2 bedroom apartment that can accommodate up to 6 people.Master bedroom has a King size bed, and second bedroom has two Full size beds.**No Pets Please!**Guest accessApartment has gated parking space for up to 2 vehicles, free ofcharge and it's walking distance to town, restaurants, beautiful beaches and night life.Other things to noteApartment has brand new air conditioning in both bedrooms as well as the family/ dining area, to help make your stay very comfortable.Beach towels and beach chairs are also available, as well as washer/dryer for use.*The building is equipped with a back-up generator and water cistern.** No pets allowed!**
